tasks.story: As the product owner, I want the CC0 kit to actually sound like a coherent drum kit, because kit v1 failed the human listen-through (synth D&B kick/snare, digitally silent ride, cross-kit tonal chaos, wild level spread).
tasks.title: Re-source kit v2 after listen-through rejection of kit v1
constraints: CC0 only (Legal-bro lock). CC-BY/CC-BY-SA sources evaluated and rejected (AVL Drumkits, Salamander).
Human ear gates every pick: two audition rounds on an A/B page before swap.
tasks.acceptance: User approves kit in listen-through; all 13 files CC0 with per-file provenance in CREDITS.md; app serves all 13 assets 200 OK.
tasks.result: Kit v2 assembled from three CC0 sets after two user audition rounds: 9 voices from Sonic Pi bundled samples (kick=Zajo/4832; toms/hats/crash/ride all one creator menegass/100053-100066; stick=looppool elec_tick), snare+rimshot from Virtuosity Drums (sfzinstruments, one session, mid mics), clap=DigitalUnderglow/745868, claves=MarleneAyni/90017. All processed to 44.1kHz/16-bit WAV, peak-normalized to fixed kit-balance map. CREDITS.md rewritten with per-file provenance + processing record. Verified: all 13 assets 200 OK on dev server, byte-exact to approved audition files, Web Audio decode confirmed in-session. Virtuosity full-kit variant kept as documented fallback.
